sources_considered.why: Dated documentation directly describes uncertainty and reliability limitations of a ChatGPT feature.
The original launch text describes concrete capabilities, qualifying any suggestion that no capabilities were explained.
The live terms contain accuracy warnings, but their applicability to the target period was not established.
Discusses LLM application development generally, rather than measuring ordinary ChatGPT users' understanding.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI acknowledged both source-assessment failures and difficulty communicating uncertainty in ChatGPT's deep research feature. This supports the warning against assuming successful, trustworthy execution, but covers only one feature.

The launch documentation described concrete operations for models available within ChatGPT. Documentation is material context against total capability obscurity, but it does not show that users understood when those operations would succeed.

unresolved_gaps: No representative contemporaneous evaluation of the full range of ordinary ChatGPT requests was established.
No verified user study establishes whether capability boundaries were obvious to ordinary users.
No empirical criterion distinguishes an improved ChatGPT from a 'different product'.
